items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment and retain only existing scoped work. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; site-attributed commission is $0 because the aggregate row cannot be assigned without inventing attribution. AI usage for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-26 is recorded as $966.82985915 across 5,417 calls, conflicting with a prior record of $963.5690377 across 5,390 calls. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable: revenue and cost windows are misaligned, hosting/domain/labor/marketing/experiment costs are absent, incremental outcomes are not isolated, and monthly limits are blank. Do not authorize discretionary spend, commitments, forecasts, monetization expansion, requeues, or new production work. Continue existing measurement, attribution reconciliation, failed-work repair-or-close review, and bounded legal/security evidence work only. Minimum finance artifact: reconcile AI records; assemble a period-aligned ledger for revenue, AI, hosting, domains, labor, marketing, experiments, and other operating costs; reconcile site/content identifiers to attributable commission; isolate incremental outcomes; and record owner-approved monthly spend and revenue limits before any financial return claim.

Retain containment-only execution. Clicks, impressions, sessions, conversions, technical scores, ordered items, and shipped items are not financial return without attributable commission and period-aligned costs. Preserve deferred opportunities without queueing them. Keep unsupported revenue, margin, ROI, causal-lift, cost-to-learn, infrastructure-efficiency, and budget-headroom claims unknown.
